risk_flags.description: The report commitment is ambiguous about when conversion happens. The project requires CAD to be converted at add/write time and reports to total stored USD, so the contract should explicitly avoid report-time reconversion.
risk_flags.span: tally report correctly aggregates CAD-denominated expenses (converted to USD) in its output

risk_flags.description: The testing commitment only pins the rate, but the requested behavioral surface includes both add and report. A rate-only test could miss a broken CLI add path or report aggregation path.
risk_flags.span: A new test in tests/test_rates.py (or a clearly named test file) pins the CAD rate: to_usd(100.0, 'CAD') == 73.0

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that report handling could be implemented as report-time conversion instead of aggregating the USD amount stored at write time.
